decisions.answer: One coherent V0.11 architecture change with phased downstream work items.
Use ordered typed explore, challenge, clarify, and validate strategies while Core owns question admission, coverage, closure, and ordering.
Use a host-owned ProviderToolchainManager; adapters cannot download tools.
Use a Core-owned ExecutionReceiptRecorder for canonical raw and redacted provider evidence.
Ship Godot support as an optional pack with no Godot dependency in Generic Core.
Expose read-only compact traceability queries with exact evidence expansion.
Use separate implementation and evidence-sealing Git commits.
Attach local-only performance telemetry to ModuleExecutionRecord through a cross-cutting metrics service.
Keep four repository-scoped ChatGPT Desktop skills as non-authoritative host guidance.
Keep all upstream tools as bounded adapters or strategies, never whole-workflow owners.
